provenance: Phase 1 smoke items authored in this repository using the TREC-6 coarse label taxonomy (ABBR, DESC, ENTY, HUM, LOC, NUM). The real TREC question-classification set is loaded with pinned ids in Phase 2. Grading logic (label extraction and exact match against the 6 classes) is identical across phases.
license: Authored smoke items; TREC data is for research use
label_help: ABBR=abbreviation, DESC=description/definition, ENTY=entity, HUM=human, LOC=location, NUM=numeric

items.question: What is the capital of France?
